trap.label: if misto
trap.wrong: If I studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
trap.right: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
trap.why: Em português usamos “se eu tivesse estudado, seria”. O brasileiro simplifica if + passado simples. Em inglês misto: if + past perfect, would + base.

mcq.q: If I ___ medicine, I would be a doctor now.
If she were taller, she ___ have played.
If he had saved, he ___ rich now.

fix.wrong: If I studied law, I would be a lawyer now.
fix.right: If I had studied law, I would be a lawyer now.

fix.wrong: If he had saved, he would had money.
fix.right: If he had saved, he would have money.

fix.wrong: If I would have left, I would be there.
fix.right: If I had left, I would be there.

rewrite.prompt: Misto: “I didn’t study law, so I am not a lawyer.”
rewrite.answer: If I had studied law, I would be a lawyer.

rewrite.prompt: Misto: “He didn’t save, so he has no money.”
rewrite.answer: If he had saved, he would have money.

rewrite.prompt: Misto: “She didn’t go, so she is not here.”
rewrite.answer: If she had gone, she would be here.
